title: Among female superheroes with missing weight data, find those whose height
question: Among female superheroes with missing weight data, find those whose height exceeds 80% of the average height of all non-human superheroes published by Dark Horse Comics. Return their names and the number of superpowers they possess.

prediction.sql:
SELECT T1."XCL_019", COUNT(T2."XCL_013") AS superpower_count
FROM superhero AS T1
INNER JOIN gender AS T3 ON T1."XCL_021" = T3."XCL_007"
INNER JOIN hero_power AS T2 ON T1."XCL_018" = T2."XCL_012"
WHERE T3."XCL_008" = 'Female'
  AND T1."XCL_029" IS NULL
  AND T1."XCL_028" > 0.8 * (
      SELECT AVG(T4."XCL_028")
      FROM superhero AS T4
      INNER JOIN publisher AS T5 ON T4."XCL_026" = T5."XCL_014"
      INNER JOIN race AS T6 ON T4."XCL_025" = T6."XCL_016"
      WHERE T5."XCL_015" = 'Dark Horse Comics'
        AND T6."XCL_017" <> 'Human'
  )
GROUP BY T1."XCL_018"
